events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey sequence files and run banned term checks
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md && ls workshop-plan/sequences/ && git status --short workshop-plan/sequences cloud/src/generated | head; echo ---; grep -nciE 'build pass|live pass|webinar' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md; grep -nP '[\x{2013}\x{2014}]' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | head; echo dates; grep -nEi '\b(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]* [0-9]{1,2}\b|20[0-9]{2}|\b(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday)\b' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | head -20; echo; cat workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md | head -120

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check dashes, run confirmation check, view builder, find card names in app
events.input: $ echo dashes; perl -CSD -ne 'print "$.: $_" if /[\x{2012}-\x{2015}]| - |--/ && !/^\|[-|]+\|$/ && !/^---$/' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | head; echo check; python3 workshop-plan/sequences/check_confirmation.py 2>&1 | tail -5; echo build; cat workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py; echo; git status --short cloud/src/generated workshop-plan/sequences; grep -rnE "Describe your business|Choose your tools|Day 0|Start cards|Six short|six questions" app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.json -i | cut -c1-220 | head -30; ls app/src/app | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify card names, VIP wording and contact fields against the code
events.input: $ grep -rnoiE ".{0,80}(Describe your business|Choose your tools|Day 0|Start cards|six (short )?questions|10 min|2 min).{0,80}" app/src/app/onboarding app/src/lib app/src/data 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | head -40; echo ---VIP; grep -noiE ".{0,100}(finished|done.for.you|sequences|dashboards|pages|notes).{0,100}" app/src/app/vip/*.tsx | cut -c1-300 | head -30; echo ---fields; grep -rnoE "(day1_label|session_time|vip_url|join_page_url|cohort_dates|calendar_url|centre_url)" cloud/src --include='*.ts' | grep -v generated | sort | uniq -c | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rebuild generated copy, check drift, type check, view live reminder copy
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py && git status --short cloud/src/generated && grep -c 'Day 0 cards' cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts; grep -oE '\{\{[^}]+\}\}' cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts | sort | uniq -c; perl -CSD -ne 'print "$.: dash\n" if /[\x{2012}-\x{2015}]/' cloud/src/generated/nurture-copy.ts | head -5; (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5); sed -n 1,80p cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | cut -c1-400

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check nurture merge fields and Day 0 card names in the centre
events.input: $ grep -rnE "day1_label|vip_url|day1_when" cloud/src app/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | grep -v generated/ | cut -c1-240 | head -20; echo ---steps; grep -nE "START_STEPS\s*[:=]" -A 14 app/src/app/onboarding/onboarding-client.tsx | cut -c1-260 | head -40; echo ---names; grep -rnoiE ".{0,60}(Describe Your Business|Choose Your Tools|Add .{0,20}Calendar).{0,100}" app/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | cut -c1-260 | head -20; echo ---mins; grep -rnoiE ".{0,80}(six|6) (short )?questions.{0,60}" app/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | cut -c1-240 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate Day 0 card definitions
events.input: $ grep -rnoE ".{0,160}title: \"(Describe your business|Choose your tools)\".{0,300}" app/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | cut -c1-600 | head -6; echo ---cal; grep -rnoiE ".{0,120}title: \"[^\"]*calendar[^\"]*\".{0,200}" app/src/lib app/src/app/onboarding --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | cut -c1-420 | head -6; echo ---phase; grep -rnE "phase: \"start\"" app/src/lib --include='*.ts' -l | head; grep -rnoE "id: \"[a-z0-9-]+\", *phase: \"start\"[^}]{0,200}" app/src/lib --include='*.ts' | cut -c1-300 | head -20

events.text: Checking the prepare email's specifics (card names, question count, minutes) against the centre's real Day 0 cards.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the calendar, business and tools cards
events.input: $ sed -n 286,300p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-700; sed -n 325,330p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-500; echo ---fieldcount; awk 'NR>=293 && NR<=311' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | grep -oE '\{ *(id|key|name): "[a-z_0-9]+"' | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply reminder copy fixes and rerun all checks

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the pre.md diff and compare free and paid prepare messages
events.input: $ f=workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md && git diff -U0 -- $f | grep -E '^[+-]' | cut -c1-230; diff <(awk '/^## 2\. What to Prepare Before Day 1 \(free\)/,/^## 3\./' $f | grep -A999 '^### Email' ) <(awk '/^## 2\. What to Prepare Before Day 1 \(paid\)/,/^## 4\./' $f | grep -A999 '^### Email') | head -8; cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the edited free lane reminder sections
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && awk '/^## 4\. Day-Before Reminder \(free\)/,/^## 1\. Confirmation \(paid\)/' workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | cut -c1-260
